theater: 長江中游的武漢及鄂湘贛交會地帶

battle.name: 寧漢戰爭
battle.theater: 長江中游的武漢及鄂湘贛交會地帶
battle.brief: 寧漢戰爭是1927年7月中國國民黨內部由蔣介石領導的南京國民政府與汪精衛領導的武漢國民政府，在北伐方針、黨政路線及軍隊指揮權上對立所引發的內戰，戰區集中於長江中游。當時地面配備包括已列裝的惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873）。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍是美國陸軍制式步槍，配備於步兵連與騎兵連的射手單位，隸屬分隊至連級編制，作為主要單兵槍械使用。

countries: 寧漢戰爭不是兩個國家之間的戰爭，而是中華民國國民革命軍內部，因南京與武漢各自成立中央政府、互不承認而引發的內戰。南京方面以蔣介石建立的南京國民政府為核心，實際支撐範圍包括南京、上海、浙江、福建，以及江蘇、安徽部分地區；武漢方面以汪精衛主持的武漢國民政府為核心，控制湖北、湖南，並依靠駐紮在湖南、江西等地的國民革命軍部隊。雙方使用相同的軍旗、軍制與正式番號，因此戰爭不是外國入侵，而是同一支革命軍被兩套總部、兩套命令系統分開。李濟深、黃琪翔掌握的廣州軍隊先與武漢決裂，轉而和南京聯絡，使戰局從南京與武漢的東西對峙，擴張為武漢同時處理東線與廣東戰線的三方局面。
countriesEn: The Ninghan War was not a conflict between two foreign states. It was a civil war within the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China, caused by the Nanjing and Wuhan governments each establishing a central authority and refusing to recognize the other. The Nanjing side was centered on Chiang Kai-shek’s Nanjing National Government and was supported by Nanjing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Fujian, and parts of Jiangsu and Anhui. The Wuhan side was centered on Wang Jingwei’s Wuhan National Government, controlled Hubei and Hunan, and depended on National Revolutionary Army formations stationed in Hunan and Jiangxi. Because both sides used the same flags, titles, and military system, this was not a foreign invasion but a division of one revolutionary army between rival headquarters and chains of command. The Guangzhou forces under Li Jishen and Huang Qixiang broke with Wuhan and established contacts with Nanjing, turning the original east-west confrontation into a three-sided struggle in which Wuhan had to face both the eastern front and a war in Guangdong.
people: 蔣介石以南京國民政府主席和國民革命軍總司令的身份掌握南京方面的最高決策，關鍵軍事部署由總參謀部白崇禧等策劃，江蘇、安徽方向的野戰主力則以李宗仁所指揮的第七軍為核心。武漢方面的政治中心是汪精衛，但東征作戰主要由唐生智統率，他以第八軍軍長和東征總指揮的身份調動湖南部隊；何鍵掌握的軍隊也是西線與湘贛方向的重要力量。廣州局勢轉變後，李濟深、黃琪翔決定脫離武漢；武漢則派張發奎所部向廣州方向進取，希望切斷南京與廣州方面的聯合。蔣、汪的分歧因此不只是兩位政治人物的爭執，而是各自調動整批師、軍與地方武力的公開對抗。戰局最後轉向，主要不是某一場會戰決定，而是唐生智、何鍵等軍事首領改變政治立場，使武漢方面失去繼續東征的指揮核心。
peopleEn: Chiang Kai-shek held the highest authority on the Nanjing side as chairman of the National Government and commander in chief of the National Revolutionary Army. White Chongxi and the General Staff coordinated operational planning, while Li Zongren’s Seventh Army formed the principal field force in the Jiangsu and Anhui theater. Wang Jingwei provided the Wuhan government’s political leadership, but Tang Shengzhi directed the eastern expedition in the field as commander of the Eighth Army and expedition commander. He Jian’s troops were another major element in the Hunan and western Hunan-Jiangxi operations. After the position in Guangdong changed, Li Jishen and Huang Qixiang decided to leave the Wuhan camp, while Wuhan sent Zhang Fakui’s formations toward Guangzhou to prevent a Nanjing-Guangdong alignment. The dispute therefore extended beyond a personal rivalry between Chiang and Wang: commanders on both sides mobilized entire armies and local formations to enforce rival political claims. The eventual turn came less from one decisive battle than from Tang Shengzhi, He Jian, and other military leaders changing allegiance, depriving Wuhan of the command structure needed to continue the eastern advance.
kits: 步兵作戰主要依靠漢陽八八式步槍，使用7.92毫米毛瑟步槍彈；機槍有Maxim M1910式水冷重機槍，部分受美援或中央軍裝備影響的部隊使用Browning M1917式重機槍，後者彈藥為.30-06。炮兵可見七五式75毫米山炮與八八式75毫米野炮，前者以馱載方式投入山地和狹窄道路，後者由馬匹牽引；兩者使用75毫米榴彈或霰彈，不能因口徑相同便假定所有炮兵單位的瞄準、發射諸元完全一致。基層部隊配備的Brodie M1915式鋼盔、軍用帆布裝具、皮帶及木製彈藥箱，均屬1927年前已在國民革命軍使用的實物。運轉主要依靠鐵路列車、馬匹、騾子、牛車與腳踏車，少數Ford Model T卡車只承擔指揮所聯絡和輕量物資輸送，不能把後勤描述成機械化。南京方面可借滬寧鐵路、長江航運和蚌埠、蕪湖等轉運點向前線送兵送彈；武漢方面則利用京漢、粵漢鐵路及南潯鐵路，把部隊從鄂、湘、贛方向推向安徽與江西北部。不同步槍、機槍和炮彈批次並存，使各軍即使在相同路線上調動，也必須分別計算攜行量、馬匹負重與前送節奏。
kitsEn: Infantry relied chiefly on the Hanyang Type 88 rifle chambered in 7.92 mm Mauser ammunition. Machine-gun holdings included the Maxim M1910 water-cooled heavy machine gun, while some formations in the central or American-assisted forces used the Browning M1917 heavy machine gun with .30-06 ammunition. Artillery types included the Type 75 75 mm pack gun and the Type 88 75 mm field gun. The pack gun could be moved over mountain tracks and narrow roads, while the field gun depended on horse traction. Both fired 75 mm high-explosive or shrapnel shells, but the shared caliber did not mean that every artillery unit possessed identical sights and firing data. Brodie M1915 steel helmets, canvas field equipment, leather belts, and wooden ammunition boxes were all established items in National Revolutionary Army service before 1927. Movement depended principally on railway trains, horses, mules, ox carts, and bicycles. A small number of Ford Model T trucks handled command communications and light cargo but did not make the logistics system motorized. Nanjing drew supplies through the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway, Yangtze shipping, and transfer points such as Bengbu and Wuhu. Wuhan used the Beijing-Hankou, Canton-Hankou, and Nanchang-Jiujiang railways to move troops from Hubei, Hunan, and Jiangxi toward Anhui and northern Jiangxi. The coexistence of different weapons and ammunition lots meant that formations moving along the same route still had to calculate carrying capacity, mule loads, and forward-delivery intervals separately.
tactics: 武漢方面的東征規劃不是一支部隊沿一條公路直取南京，而是以湘贛方向為主要推進軸，部隊可由長沙經株洲、萍鄉、宜春向南昌移動，再接南潯鐵路通往九江；另一支由湖北沿江向安徽方向策應，企圖先與安徽的南京軍接觸，再向南京外圍施壓。這種多路展開能增加受攻方向，卻也拉長指揮與補給距離，使湖南、江西、湖北和皖中各軍必須協調不同的出擊時刻。南京方面則利用李宗仁第七軍在安徽方向建立較短內線，以南京、蕪湖、蚌埠及沿江鐵路節點為支撐，設法截斷向江西北部推進的縱隊。前線出現接觸時，雙方仍沿用國民革命軍的師級編制與一般結合戰術：七五炮先掩護道路渡口和兵力展開，重機槍封鎖坡地、鐵路路基與村鎮外圍，步兵再以散開隊形接近，最後佔領高地和交通點。火力和運動並沒有問題，真正的弱點是命令經常在南京與武漢的兩套參謀系統間中斷，地方部隊也可能根據自身利益選擇進退。因此，戰役沒有演變為對南京的正面總攻，決定性反而轉向鐵路控制、部隊忠誠和指揮權轉移。
tacticsEn: The Wuhan eastern expedition was not designed as a single force driving straight along one road to Nanjing. Its principal axis ran through Hunan and Jiangxi: troops could move from Changsha through Zhuzhou, Pingxiang, and Yichun toward Nanchang, then connect with the Nanchang-Jiujiang Railway. Another column was to move eastward through Hubei along the Yangtze toward Anhui, make contact with the Nanjing forces there, and then press toward Nanjing’s outer defenses. This multi-axis plan offered several approaches but also stretched command and supply lines. Units from Hunan, Jiangxi, Hubei, and central Anhui had to coordinate different moments of departure. Nanjing, by contrast, used Li Zongren’s Seventh Army to establish a shorter inner line in Anhui and based its movement on Nanjing, Wuhu, Bengbu, and riverside railway nodes, seeking to cut the columns advancing through northern Jiangxi. Where local contact occurred, both sides continued to use National Revolutionary Army divisional organization and conventional combined-arms methods. Seventy-five-millimetre guns covered road crossings and deployment areas, heavy machine guns dominated slopes, railway embankments, and approaches to settlements, and dispersed infantry closed in to occupy high ground and transport points. Firepower and maneuver were available, but the structural weakness lay in orders passing between two rival staffs and in local formations deciding whether to continue the advance. Consequently, the campaign never became a frontal assault on Nanjing; railway control, unit loyalty, and the transfer of command became decisive.
data: 1927年4月12日，蔣介石在上海對共產黨人展開清黨；4月18日，南京國民政府正式成立，南京與武漢的兩個中央政府至此並立。四月底，馮玉祥部已推進至鄭州一線，北伐的主要軍事成果確立，但北伐成功沒有消除國民黨內部的權力爭端。五月，武漢方面也實行清黨並驅逐蘇聯顧問，與南京的聯合公開破裂；唐生智、何鍵等湖南軍人開始籌劃東征。六月，武漢以唐生智第八軍為主要力量，命令各路由湖南向江西推進，並由湖北向安徽方向策應；南京則調動李宗仁第七軍及南京、蕪湖、蚌埠一線的部隊，部署於安徽和江西北部。兩個作戰方向在江西北部與安徽沿江一帶互相逼近，前哨接觸零星發生，但任何一側都沒有突破到南京城下。七月，李濟深、黃琪翔的廣州軍公開脫離武漢並倒向南京，張發奎奉命南下，武漢東征軍同時失去南方的戰略縱深與部分兵力，攻勢因而停滯。八月上旬，唐生智及何鍵等陸續通電支持南京，部隊停止向西進攻並轉為接受南京方面的編制，武漢的軍事指揮核心至此瓦解。八月下旬至九月，南京與武漢進行政府機關和軍隊接收；九月武漢國民政府遷往南京，中央政治與軍事權力形式上歸於南京。各次戰鬥的傷亡數字沒有可信而一致的統計，本文因此不列精確總數。
dataEn: On 12 April 1927, Chiang Kai-shek carried out the purge of Communists in Shanghai. On 18 April, the Nanjing National Government was formally established, creating two rival central governments in Nanjing and Wuhan. By the end of April, Feng Yuxiang’s forces had advanced to the Zhengzhou area, and the principal military results of the Northern Expedition had been achieved, but victory did not resolve the struggle inside the Nationalist Party. In May, Wuhan also purged Communists and expelled Soviet advisers, openly breaking with Nanjing. Tang Shengzhi, He Jian, and other Hunan commanders began organizing an eastern expedition. In June, the Eighth Army under Tang formed the principal Wuhan striking force. Orders sent the columns from Hunan toward Jiangxi and another force from Hubei toward Anhui, while Nanjing moved Li Zongren’s Seventh Army and units based at Nanjing, Wuhu, and Bengbu into Anhui and northern Jiangxi. The opposing deployments drew close in northern Jiangxi and along the Anhui river corridor, with scattered local contacts, but neither side broke through to the approaches of Nanjing. In July, Li Jishen and Huang Qixiang’s Guangzhou forces openly left Wuhan and aligned themselves with Nanjing. Zhang Fakui was sent south, forcing Wuhan to divide its forces and depriving the eastern expedition of strategic depth. In early August, Tang Shengzhi, He Jian, and other commanders sent declarations supporting Nanjing. Their troops stopped the western advance and accepted Nanjing’s command structure, breaking the Wuhan military leadership. During late August and September, the two governments negotiated the transfer of ministries and formations. In September, the Wuhan National Government moved to Nanjing, and central political and military authority was formally consolidated there. No reliable, consistent casualty total exists for the individual clashes, so no precise aggregate figure is given here.
cause: 寧漢對立的根源是北伐勝利後出現兩個都自稱代表國民黨的中央權力中心。南京方面控制東南較發達的沿海城市、鐵路和中央政府的形式資源；武漢方面則掌握國民黨中央執行委員會、蘇聯顧問時期形成的政治網絡，以及湖北、湖南的軍隊根據地。國民黨內部原本只是策略、黨務和軍事指揮上的分歧，但蔣介石在南京成立政府、武漢隨後清黨並排斥共產黨與蘇聯顧問後，分歧變成誰有資格建立唯一中央政府的根本衝突。各軍首領不只服從政治領袖，也維護自己的地盤、兵源、軍械與升遷管道；唐生智、何鍵、李宗仁等人因此成為兩套政治主張之間的軍事橋樑。武漢若能以東征迫使南京屈服，便可重新取得中央主導權；南京若維持短供應線、控制安徽和江西北部的交通節點，再吸收或分化武漢部隊，也能削弱對方的政治基礎。這使一場原本由政令分歧引發的衝突，最終必須由軍隊移動、鐵路運輸和指揮權歸屬來解決。
causeEn: The root of the Ninghan confrontation was the emergence, after the Northern Expedition’s success, of two rival central authorities each claiming to represent the Nationalist Party. Nanjing possessed the principal coastal cities, railways, and formal resources of the central government in eastern China. Wuhan retained the Nationalist Party’s central executive apparatus, the political network formed during the period of Soviet advisers, and military bases in Hubei and Hunan. What had begun as disagreement over strategy, party affairs, and command became a fundamental conflict over which authority could establish the sole central government after Chiang formed a government in Nanjing and Wuhan subsequently purged Communists and expelled Soviet advisers. Army commanders did not simply obey political leaders; they also protected their own bases, sources of recruits, arms, and advancement. Tang Shengzhi, He Jian, Li Zongren, and others consequently became military links between competing political programs. If the Wuhan eastern expedition compelled Nanjing to yield, Wuhan could recover control of the center. If Nanjing maintained short supply lines, held the transport nodes of Anhui and northern Jiangxi, and then absorbed or divided Wuhan formations, it could destroy the political basis of the challenge. A conflict that began as disagreement over orders therefore had to be settled through troop movement, railway transport, and the final location of command.
impact: 軍事上，寧漢戰爭沒有留下可信的統一傷亡總表；各方戰報常把作戰地域內的全部傷病、失散與逃亡數量混列，若直接相加，只會製造虛假精確度。可以確定的是，炮兵消耗、鐵路運輸中斷、部隊分散與重新編組都曾發生，部分槍械和彈藥隨部隊轉手，而前線始終沒有出現一方全滅或南京被攻陷的結果。政治上，武漢方面的中央政府失去獨立地位，蔣介石控制下的南京成為唯一全國性中央權力，第九章所述的軍事轉移也證明軍隊可以在短時間內決定中央政府的存廢。區域格局則變得更複雜：何鍵等湖南實力派保有自己的地盤，廣州另立政治中心，南京對全國的集中因此只是形式上的完成。長期看，北伐所建立的統一軍事架構沒有消失，黨政軍的裂痕卻被保留下來；中央政府雖獲得了更多軍隊和資源，也同時面臨各地軍事首領要求相應權力的新壓力。
impactEn: Militarily, the Ninghan War left no reliable aggregate casualty table. Contemporary reports often mixed casualties from the operational area with sick, stragglers, and missing men, so simply adding the figures would create false precision. What can be established is that artillery expenditure, interruptions to railway traffic, unit dispersal, and reorganization occurred; some weapons and ammunition changed hands with formations; and neither side was annihilated or saw Nanjing fall. Politically, the Wuhan government lost its separate central status, and Chiang Kai-shek’s Nanjing became the sole national central authority. The transfer of military allegiance described in the chronology also demonstrated that an army could determine the survival of a central government within a matter of days. The regional settlement was less tidy. He Jian and other Hunan commanders retained their local power, while Guangzhou established another political center. Nanjing’s national consolidation was therefore formal rather than complete. In the longer term, the unified military structure created by the Northern Expedition survived, but the political divisions inside the party and army remained. The central government gained more troops and material resources while also inheriting the need to accommodate regional commanders whose strength had been demonstrated by the conflict itself.
resultEn: The military result was a halt to the Wuhan eastern expedition in early August, when Tang Shengzhi, He Jian, and associated commanders declared for Nanjing and their formations ceased to advance. Nanjing incorporated the Eighth Army system and other returning formations through their existing command channels rather than defeating and disbanding them on the battlefield. Li Zongren’s Seventh Army remained the principal Nanjing formation in the Anhui theater, while the Wuhan command structure lost the ability to coordinate an offensive against the capital. The political result followed in September, when the Wuhan National Government transferred its institutions to Nanjing and the competing governments were formally merged under the Nanjing leadership. There was no storming of Nanjing and no single annihilating battle; the campaign ended through the defection of key military commanders, the transfer of orders and formations, and the negotiated relocation of the Wuhan government. Li Jishen and Huang Qixiang’s Guangzhou regime continued to operate separately, so the southern dispute was not solved by this settlement. The final balance was nevertheless clear: Nanjing retained the national government and the central army, Wuhan ceased to exist as an independent military-political center, and the authority established by Chiang Kai-shek became the recognized framework for the next phase of Nationalist government.
